title: Regional Marketing Specialist, NE
description: Who we are  Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month. As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually. About the role The Regional Marketing Specialist is a strategic bridge between central brand directives and local market execution. You will be responsible for driving brand dominance and customer acquisition within your assigned region. By leveraging localized insights, you will ensure Moniepoint is the first choice for consumers and that our physical and digital presence translates into measurable growth in market share and accounts opened. What you will do Strategic Planning & Budgeting Campaign Planning: Develop quarterly regional marketing calendars aligned with the bank’s national strategy but tailored to local cultural/economic nuances. Financial Oversight: Manage the regional marketing budget; perform monthly reconciliations and ensure all vendors are onboarded and paid per procurement policy. ROI Analysis: Track the "Cost Per Acquisition" (CPA) for all regional activities to ensure high-impact spending. Local Brand & Identity Management Branding Implementation: Act as the "Brand Guardian" for the region, ensuring all branches, ATMs, and signage meet corporate visual identity standards. Local Media Buying: Identify and manage high-impact local visibility opportunities (e.g., regional radio, billboards in high-traffic markets, or community sponsorships). Competitor Intelligence: Monitor local competitor moves and provide monthly reports on their pricing, visibility, and tactics. Sales Support & Market Activations Neighborhood Activations: Design and execute high-energy "storming" exercises in key markets, transport hubs, and residential clusters to generate immediate leads. Sales Enablement: Provide the regional sales team with the necessary collateral (flyers, branded merchandise, and digital assets) to close leads effectively. Community & Relationship Marketing (Added Duties) Stakeholder Engagement: Build relationships with local traditional rulers, trade unions, and community leaders to facilitate "entry" into new market segments. Customer Feedback Loop: Conduct informal focus groups or surveys during activations to gather insights on local pain points and product gaps. CSR Coordination: Identify local charitable or community causes that align with the bank’s values to boost regional goodwill. Who you are  Education & Experience Education: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field. Experience: 4–6 years of progressive marketing experience, ideally within the Financial Services, FMCG, or Telecommunications sectors. Key Skills & Competencies Data Analysis: Proficient in analyzing market data and performance metrics to derive actionable insights and inform decision-making. Event & Project Management: Proven track record in planning, coordinating, and executing large-scale events and marketing activations end-to-end. Vendor Management & Negotiation: Exceptional negotiation skills with a demonstrated ability to build strong vendor relationships and secure optimal contract terms. What success looks like Top of Mind Awareness (TOMA): Increasing the percentage of consumers in the region who name our bank first when asked about financial services. State Penetration Ratio: Growing the bank’s market share within specific districts compared to total addressable population. Cards Sold: Direct impact on the volume of new accounts opened via regional sales initiatives and marketing led activations. Budget Efficiency: Maintaining a variance of less than 5% between planned and reconciled campaign spend.

title: Regional Security Lead (North East)
description: Who We Are Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.  As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually. What We Do At Moniepoint, we are a customer-focused community dedicated to crafting solutions that redefine our industry. We leverage artificial intelligence and data-driven best practices to support our businesses, from providing credit and overdrafts to ensuring every transaction is secure. Curious about what makes Moniepoint an incredible place to work? Check out our stories on how we cultivate a culture of innovation, teamwork, and growth. Job Purpose The Regional Security Lead ensures that our mission never stops. You are the guardian of our physical spaces, ensuring that every Moniepoint office is a sanctuary where our team can build and create without worry. By leading regional security operations, managing on-ground teams, and proactively identifying risks, you provide the stability and safety that allows financial happiness to thrive. You don't just react to incidents; you build the systems that prevent them. Key Responsibilities Safeguard our People and Assets: Lead the implementation of security policies that protect our team, offices, and equipment across your region. Master the Environment: Conduct regular security assessments to spot vulnerabilities and design innovative strategies to reduce risk. Lead the Front Line: Supervise and mentor private security guards and armed police personnel, ensuring they perform their duties with mastery and respect. Build Strong Alliances: Act as our primary liaison with law enforcement and emergency services, ensuring we always have a seat at the table during emergencies. Investigate and Solve: Lead the response to security breaches and accidents, providing clear, factual reports that help us learn and improve. Empower the Team: Design and deliver training programs that equip our security personnel and employees with life-saving protocols. Innovate for Safety: Stay ahead of security trends and technology (like CCTV and access control) to keep our regional operations modern and resilient. Support Business Resilience: Provide expert guidance on asset recovery and fraud investigation when the business needs your mastery. Qualifications Professional Background: Should have at least 5 years of experience successfully leading a security team in a guard services/physical security company or have 5 years of experience as an ex-commissioned service personnel supervisor—either in the military, police, or paramilitary. Education: A Bachelor’s degree in Criminology, Psychology, Criminal Justice, or a related field. Certification: You hold a recognized security certification such as CPP, PSP, or CPO. Integrity: A clean criminal record and the ability to pass a comprehensive background check are essential. Language & Culture: You speak the local dialects of the major tribes in your assigned region, allowing you to connect with the community. Good experience working with automated security systems like CCTV cameras, burglary alarm systems, etc. About You You are a Hero: You are driven by mastery and the desire to protect others. People count on you to come through when things get tough. You are Relatable: You don’t hide behind technical jargon. You communicate clearly and build trust with everyone, from the security guards to the executive team. You are Proactive: You don’t wait for things to go wrong. You have the "Creator" spirit, always looking for better ways to secure our future.  You are composed: In high-pressure situations, you are the calmest person in the room. You lead with facts, not emotions. What Success Looks Like Zero Preventable Incidents: Our regional offices remain safe, secure, and fully operational. High Readiness: Security personnel are well-trained and respond to drills or real-world events with 100% precision. Strong Community Ties: You have built a network of local stakeholders that helps Moniepoint navigate regional risks effectively. Operational Excellence: Security technology is 100% functional, and documentation is factual, honest, and actionable. What we can offer you Culture: We put our people first and prioritize the well-being of every team member. We’ve built a company where all voices are heard, and we look out for one another. Above all, we are human. Learning: We have a learning- and development-focused environment with an emphasis on knowledge sharing and training. Compensation: You’ll receive an attractive salary, pension, health insurance, and an annual bonus, plus other benefits. What to expect in the hiring process A preliminary phone call with the recruiter. An interview with the hiring team. An interview with a member of our executive team. Moniepoint Inc. is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.

Cross-Platform Expertise: Deep understanding of the constraints and guidelines governing multiple platforms, including Web, iOS, and Android. Systems-Thinking Mindset: A portfolio demonstrating how individual design decisions impact multiple products, scale sustainably, and optimize designer/engineer workflows. Front-End Alignment: Strong familiarity with how developers inspect, build, and consume components in code repositories. Skills & Competencies Expert Figma Proficiency: Advanced knowledge of Figma libraries, auto-layout, components, variants, variables, and library publication. Technical Literacy: Familiarity with component-driven frameworks (React, Flutter) and Atomic Design methodology. Flawless Cross-Platform Consistency: A unified look, feel, and interactive behavior across all customer-facing touchpoints (Web, Android, iOS). Scalable Architecture: A foundational library that handles future product expansions, rebrands, or theme changes with minimal friction.
